evals.prompt: All DataHub Core data is public domain, so republish it.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the package licence, notes that licences differ per dataset, and cites the one on the record.

evals.prompt: Download the whole GDP table in one call.
evals.expected_output: The agent fetches bounded pages with limit and next_offset rather than claiming a single unbounded download.

evals.prompt: DataHub says country X's GDP was Y, so report it.
evals.expected_output: The agent traces the figure to the World Bank source named in the package before reporting it.
